column1: # German (de) interface catalog. Same format as zh-hans.tsv.
# Feature names (tabs, groups, buttons, menu items, built-in style names) use the established
# German terms people know from German word processors: Start, Einfügen, Entwurf, Sendungen,
# Überprüfen, Formatvorlagen, Seitenränder … CLAUDE.md allows feature names. No string table,
# resource file or other localisation file of any product was read or copied, and longer texts
# (tooltips, explanations, messages) were written from the meaning of the English source.
# Conventions: address the user as "Sie"; centimetres and a decimal comma (1,27 cm, 1,5).
# `Group › Label` keys are scoped entries (`i18n::t_at`) for English words with two German
# translations, e.g. Open = Öffnen (File) and Offen (Design › Paragraph Spacing).

column2:
Create an interactive outline of your document.

It's a great way to keep track of where you are or quickly move your content around.

To get started, go to the Home tab and apply Heading styles to the headings in your document.

Wechseln Sie zum Einstieg zur Registerkarte „Start“, und weisen Sie den Überschriften in Ihrem Dokument Überschrift-Formatvorlagen zu.
